headline: Executive order sets up sanctions on people responsible for repression in Cuba and for threats to U.S. security and foreign policy.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates sanctions aimed at people or groups the U.S. government says are responsible for repression in Cuba. It also targets those seen as threatening U.S. national security or foreign policy. No summary was provided, so details such as who can be named, what penalties apply, or which agencies carry it out are not known from the source.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups linked to repression in Cuba
who_it_affects.how: They may face U.S. sanctions, which often include blocked property and limits on dealing with Americans.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses and individuals with ties to Cuba
who_it_affects.how: They may need to avoid deals with anyone sanctioned under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 1, 2026; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
